description: Public reference decompositions for RoboTwin 50 tasks. They seed retrieval and training analysis only; they are not executable plans and do not encode simulator state.
selection_policy: retrieve candidates from the current public observation and instruction; a planner may reject, reorder, or replace every reference step.

supervision_contract.initial_step: reference_decomposition[0] is the conventional first-step retrieval target for offline supervision; it is not forced at runtime.
supervision_contract.full_process: reference_decomposition contains semantic candidates for the whole task and may be reordered, skipped, or expanded by the VLM planner.

binding_sources.object: noun phrase explicitly present in the public task instruction or a current public camera observation
binding_sources.objects: object list explicitly present in the public task instruction or current public camera observation
binding_sources.target: destination noun phrase explicitly present in the public task instruction or current public camera observation
binding_sources.tool: tool noun phrase explicitly present in the public task instruction or current public camera observation
binding_sources.arm: explicit arm assignment in the instruction, otherwise a VLM choice from the public observation
binding_sources.orientation: orientation phrase explicitly present in the public task instruction
binding_sources.relation: spatial relation explicitly present in the public task instruction
binding_sources.order: ordering rule explicitly present in the public task instruction
